test_title: PYST 23: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 15 Mar 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

The teacher asked if everyone was present in the class that day.

options.text: The teacher said, "Is everyone present in the class today?"
The teacher said, "Was everyone present in the class that day?"
The teacher said, "Was everyone present in the class today?"
The teacher said, "Is everyone present in the class that day?"

solution:
The correct answer is **"The teacher said, "Is everyone present in the class today?"".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's see the type of sentence and its direct speech given in the sentence.
 
 
• Here, The reporting verb is "**asked". **
 
• **"Asked" **is the reporting verb and it is used when we convert **"Verbal questions into Indirect Speech".**
 
• **"IF" **is working as conjunction. It simply means that this Indirect speech of **Verbal Question**
 
• In this part of the sentence **"if everyone was present in the class that day." was is used**
 
• "**Is"(Direct Speech) **must be converted into "**was"(Indirect speech)**
 
• We need to find the option in which **"is" **is used.
 
• The option no 1 is the correct answer.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

 
• We may get confused between option no 1 and Option no 4
 
 
• Both may sound same
 
• But there is a small difference between "that day"
 
• In option no 1 word "**Today" is used at the ending.**
 
• **However, **In option no 4 word "**That day " at the ending.**
 
• **Hence, That day is used in indirect speech we need a sentence of Direct speech in which Today is used**
 
• **In option no 1 Today is used**
 
• **In option no 4 that day is used (wrong answer)**
 
 

** ****​So the correct answer is** *"**The teacher said, "Is everyone present in the class today?"*
